# SB-1041 Safety bulletin: airborne dust from blasting

Revision: Rev A  
Plant: P3, line P3-L2  
Equipment: EQ-P3-L2-HT03

Hazard description
Airborne dust generated during blasting and subsequent handling in the heat treat area presents an inhalation and combustible-dust hazard. Fine particulates can reduce visibility at the workface, contaminate adjacent equipment, and settle on heated surfaces creating secondary ignition sources. Dust accumulation on electrical cabinets, motors, and moving assemblies increases the risk of equipment malfunction and uncontrollable fire propagation. Personnel working near blasting operations are at increased risk of respiratory irritation and long-term exposure effects if controls are inadequate. Contaminated surfaces can also compromise the performance of lubricants and seals used on Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #3 (EQ-P3-L2-HT03); the approved lubricant part number for Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #3 (EQ-P3-L2-HT03) is CFW-LUB-159.

Affected equipment
Primary affected equipment: EQ-P3-L2-HT03 and adjacent handling conveyors, enclosures, and electrical cabinets in the P3-L2 line. Areas downwind of blasting cells within Plant P3 where dust may travel or settle are also considered affected. Maintenance tools and PPE storage located near blasting zones are included due to potential contamination.

Required controls
- Engineering: Ensure local exhaust ventilation and capture systems are operational and positioned to contain dust at source. Verify enclosure seals and differential airflow patterns to minimize dust migration to EQ-P3-L2-HT03.
- Administrative: Restrict access to blasting areas during active blasting and until post-blast clearance checks are documented. Implement enhanced cleaning protocols for surfaces around EQ-P3-L2-HT03 and downstream equipment. Refer to maintenance guidance and lubrication requirements in MM-P3-L2-HT03 and operational procedures in SOP-P3-L2-02 and SOP-P3-L2-03 for coordinated actions.
- PPE: Require appropriate respiratory protection and eye protection for personnel performing blast, cleanup, or inspection tasks until airborne concentrations are confirmed controlled.
- Housekeeping: Increase frequency of vacuuming with HEPA-equipped units and avoid dry sweeping. Inspect lubricant application points for contamination and confirm use of CFW-LUB-159 as specified.

Effective date
Effective immediately.
